column2: Unless the seven $$封印$$ on Heaven's throne are broken...
the $$世界$$ will remain in its evil state, but...
when $$神の子羊$$ breaks each $$封印$$ in turn...
disaster, death, and conflict will spread throughout the $$世界$$...
and the earth will be beset by unprecedented chaos and calamity!
Then, when seven trumpets are sounded in turn by the angels...
the restraint that held back the $$世界$$'s collapse will come undone...
and apocalyptic calamity will begin to assail the $$世界$$ at an accelerating pace...
Until at last, a fiery-red dragon with seven heads and ten horns...
and the one called the Devil or $$サタン$$ will appear...
and fight $$ミカエル$$ and the warrior angels who represent Heaven.
In truth, within this vast $$世界$$...
there is neither good nor evil...
But just as all things have light and shadow...
for the idea called good to exist...
the idea called evil had to be created, even by force!!
Thus the one God of this $$世界$$ created two faces, good god and evil god...
by creating black and white $$大天使$$s...
Originally, the word angel...
means mala'akh: the shadowed aspect of God...
The $$大悪神$$ once feared by people and called $$ゴッド$$...
and the $$大善神$$ called $$サタン$$ receive orders from...
one and the very same person!!
That person is the Creator who made this universe...
and the one God of this $$世界$$!!
$$ハ・サタン$$ originally means the chief prosecutor God sent to watch over the people of the earth...
In that sense, it is merely an office title!!
Belial = $$サタン$$
$$ベルゼブブ$$ = $$サタン$$
$$メフィスト$$ = $$サタン$$
All of them are chosen ones whom God himself sent to watch over people...
You, who should become the next $$サタン$$...
You, who should become the next $$ゴッド$$...
God is testing whether you are truly worthy to be entrusted with that new $$世界$$...
God is testing you!
